title: OtoFL: a federated learning benchmark for otoscopy
description: Code for the manuscript "When does federated learning help otoscopy? A two-hospital benchmark of federated strategies and differential privacy" (under review). It combines two public otoscopy datasets from hospitals in Chile and Turkey, groups near-duplicate video frames before splitting, and compares federated strategies (FedAvg, FedProx, SCAFFOLD, FedBN, AP-FedBN, FedPer and others) with local and centralised training and sample-level differential privacy. The repository contains the training code, the exact arguments of every run in the paper, and the scripts that produce every table and figure.
